listing.name: The Maw — The Maw — Linux Recompilation (thefixinhixon)
listing.summary: The project describes Linux as playable, with cache and shared-memory files left after crashes. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own The Maw Xbox 360 XBLA package or its complete extracted files. XBLA title 584108C2.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use Linux AppImage/folder ZIP and import own Maw XBLA package; Windows game build unfinished.

warnings: The project describes Linux as playable, with cache and shared-memory files left after crashes.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
